versionFieldNote: Be explicit about what is enforced and what is not. `allowlistVersion` is MACHINE-CHECKED: extraction/verify_all.py fails the run if it drifts from tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json#version, and extraction/prove_drift.sh proves that check catches drift. The `counts` block below is also MACHINE-CHECKED — verify_all.py recomputes every number from the actual files on disk and fails on any mismatch, likewise drift-proven. `repositoryVersion` and `pageSpecVersion` are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY, hand-maintained markers; nothing checks them automatically, and neither implies any enforcement guarantee.
themeNote: The source site has NO light/dark theme switcher and no prefers-color-scheme handling anywhere in its CSS. These two "themes" are the two real SURFACE MODES that alternate section by section within one visual system. Both are validated by the schema's `theme` enum.

sourceProject.kind: pixel-faithful clone of a REAL, LIVE company website
sourceProject.frameworkNote: Read out of the real package.json at build time, not carried over from a draft. A design-repo is a SNAPSHOT, not a living mirror — if the app is later upgraded, re-diff these strings against the current package.json rather than trusting this record (MASTER-GUIDE 3.10).
sourceProject.versionControl: The source project IS a git repository (one commit, 180 tracked files). This was re-checked against CURRENT state immediately before packaging, because a .git directory was created by a concurrent process DURING this build — an earlier read of the same folder correctly showed none (MASTER-GUIDE 3.11). Verified directly, not by convention: `.gitignore` line 7 lists design-repo.zip by name, `git check-ignore -v design-repo.zip` confirms the rule matches, and `git ls-files --error-unmatch design-repo.zip` errors, so the artifact is not tracked. design-repo/ itself is currently untracked; whether to commit it is the maintainer's call and this build did not commit anything. The zip must stay gitignored and be regenerated fresh after any change, never committed alongside the live folder it is built from.

compliance.summary: The source is a real, live company's website. Three separate reproduction risks are recorded and machine-enforced where enforcement is possible: (1) real third-party trademarks, the real company wordmark and audited compliance marks — closed assetRole enum + pinned generationPolicy + a required `provenance` that forbids "generated"; (2) three COMMERCIALLY LICENSED, non-redistributable typefaces; (3) the real company's verbatim legal text on both legal routes, gated behind `requiresOperatorSuppliedText`.

countsNote: Every number above is recomputed from disk by extraction/verify_all.py#manifest-counts and the run fails on any mismatch. A hand-bumped count cannot survive here (MASTER-GUIDE 3.16).

verification.schemaOnly: python3 -c "import json;from jsonschema import Draft7Validator as V;V(json.load(open('schema/pagespec.schema.json'))).validate(json.load(open('schema/example.pagespec.json')))"
verification.dependencies: python3 >= 3.9 and the `jsonschema` package (pip install jsonschema). Every script derives its own root from __file__ and runs from any location.

entryPointsNote: Only files INSIDE design-repo/ appear here. An entry point is a promise about this package's own contents, so a zipped or standalone copy must not reference paths it does not contain (MASTER-GUIDE 3.9). Citations to the build-time evidence in the sibling source project live in extraction/measured-values.json, which degrades to a WARNING rather than a failure when no sibling tree is present.
